QuestInfo.name: [Sengoku Warriors] Tailing Haruaki
QuestInfo.1: Kenshin asks you to find out the whereabouts of the great Spirit Walker Haruaki. Collect fox tails from the area around Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.2: To find the whereabouts of the great Spirit Walker Haruaki, you collected fox tails. When you finally had enough fox tails, Haruaki was summoned.
